name: Kiln ShroudForge network probe
description: Test probe for ShroudForge's runtime.network between a joined game and the server it joined: the joined game sends a ping to the same mod on the server with runtime.network.send_mod every 10 s; the server (or the player hosting) logs the sender and its runtime.network.player_permissions, and answers. Both sides log what they see in ShroudForge's log (kiln.log mirrors it). Install it on both. Test only.
